name: round_pass
title: 置换遍数替代轮次基数
purpose: Store round pass index rather than 5-bit round base. Every valid base equals pass*(U*P), with pass in [0,PASSES-1]; recover exactly the previous Keccak round indices.
scope: All legal P/U (positive U/P and U*P dividing 24); valid token propagation from reset. No arbitrary in-flight internal state corruption equivalence claim.
risk: Constant multiplication/decode changes mapping. Old low bits may already be constant-pruned; fewer source bits do not prove area benefit.
